→ How non-reaction destroys people more than any argument
→ Who to cut from your life and how to do it cleanly

These aren't just concepts. These are laws. Apply them and watch how people treat you differently.
Stay Untouchable.

videos.title: 7 Signs Someone Secretly Looks Down On You (Even Those You'd Never Suspect)
videos.description:
ave you ever left a conversation feeling smaller, without being able to explain why? No argument. No insult. Just a quiet, uncomfortable feeling that something was off.
 
That feeling has a name. It's called contempt, and it's one of the most psychologically damaging things one person can quietly do to another. In this video, we break down 7 subtle signs that someone in your life secretly looks down on you, even if they've never said a word about it.
 
What you'll learn:
- Why contempt is more damaging than open conflict
- The 7 specific behaviors that reveal hidden contempt
- Why your brain is wired to miss these signs
- What to do once you recognize the pattern
 
This isn't about drama or paranoia. It's about learning to trust what you've already been feeling.
